title: UI风格#77 - Submarine Depth (潜艇深处)
description: 创建第77种UI风格：潜艇深处风格 - 深海压力、仪表盘、氖氧灯光。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planBY.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Submarine Depth style When color palette Then features deep sea blue, emergency red, instrument green, rust
Given Submarine Depth style When typography Then uses instrument fonts: Share Tech Mono, Roboto Mono, or Fira Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Share Tech Mono (headers 2.8rem, button 0.95rem), Roboto Mono (body 0.95rem)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Submarine Depth style When layout Then porthole frames, depth gauges, pressure meters
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: deep sea blue gradient background, sonar ping animation, green glow accents, dark blue/steel color scheme

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Submarine Depth style When UI elements Then riveted metal, gauge needles, sonar pings
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: steel borders, green/red/green gradient card tops, instrument-green glow effects, sonar ping animation, dashed border inner frame

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Submarine Depth UI When functional Then includes sonar chat, crew agents, depth stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: sonar chat, 4 crew agents (Captain/Engineer/Navigator/Torpedo) with Depth/Ready/Pressure/Hull/Course/Speed/Yield/Armed stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Submarine Depth UI When copy Then uses naval language: 'Dive', 'Surface', 'Sonar', 'Depth'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'DIVE. SURFACE. SONAR.', tagline 'CRUSH DEPTH OR BE CRUSHED', button 'PING', greeting 'Sonar contact detected. All hands on deck', status 'Diving'/'Idle', nav 'Bridge'/'Engine'/'Comms'/'Control'
